 Ashita Kashyap Updated: Oct 30, 2026, 10:23 IST ​UP School Holiday 2026: Schools closed in 60 districts on October 30 due to UPSSSC PET exam, check reason and details Schools in 60 districts of Uttar Pradesh will be closed today on October 30,2026. This holiday is being observed because the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) is conducting the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2026.
 The exam will take place at 1,372 centres across the state. For the same 35 lakh candidates have registered. The closure of schools is meant to help with managing the exam setup, traffic flow and security measures. Schools in 15 districts where the exam is not being held are expected to stay open, as usual.
 Why are schools closed in 60 districts of Uttar Pradesh on October 30? 
 The main reason behind the school holiday is the arrangement needed for UPSSSC PET 2026. The exam is run by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) for people who want to get government jobs in the state. 
 Reports say that 35.41 lakh people have signed up for the exam and the test will be held in 60 districts at 1,372 exam centres.
 Many schools and other education places are being used as exam centres. Running classes at the same time as a big competitive exam could cause trouble with safety, traffic, moving students and setting up the exam.
 The district administrations have therefore announced academic holidays to ensure that the examination takes place without disruption.
 UPSSSC PET 2026 exam dates and shift timings 
 The UPSSSC PET 2026 examination is being conducted on three dates: October 25, October 30 and November 1.
 The examination will take place in two shifts on each day.
 Examination shift Timing 
 First shift 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM 
 Second shift 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM 
 The above table shows examination shifts and timings. Therefore, candidates must check their individual admit cards for the examination date, allotted shift, centre address and reporting instructions.
 The commission had earlier scheduled the examination for October 23, 24 and 25. 
 However, it revised the schedule and shifted the remaining examination dates to October 30 and November 1.
 Will schools remain open in all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh? 
 No, the examination is being conducted in 60 districts, while 15 districts are not included in the examination schedule.
 According to the reported district wise information, schools in the following districts are expected to remain open:
 Ambedkar Nagar
 Amethi
 Ballia
 Balrampur
 Chandauli
 Chitrakoot
 Kasganj
 Kushinagar
 Lalitpur
 Mahoba
 Sambhal
 Shravasti
 Siddharthnagar
 Sultanpur
 Varanasi
 However, students and parents should check with their respective schools before travelling, as district-level holiday orders may have different coverage.
 Are teachers and school staff also getting a holiday? 
 The closure is mainly a day off for students in schools. Teachers and other school workers might still have to go to their schools if they have been given tasks related to exams.
 In Gautam Buddha Nagar for example, the local government told 32 schools that act as exam centers to stay closed for students on October 30. The school staff had to come in to handle exam work.
 Similarly, Lucknow made a day off for all students in Classes 1 to 12, in government schools aided schools and private schools that are recognized and follow different education boards.
 The specific rules depend on what the district administration says and what tasks the school has been given.
 What is UPSSSC PET 2026 and why is it important for government job aspirants? 
 The Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) is a state-level exam conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission. It is used as a step in the recruitment process for many Group C government jobs in Uttar Pradesh.
 Candidates who meet the prescribed PET eligibility and shortlisting requirements can apply or proceed to subsequent stages of recruitment, depending on the individual vacancy notification.
 The test helps the commission manage and reduce the number of applicants before moving on to more detailed exams. It is important to remember that passing the PET does not mean a candidate gets a government job.
 They must meet the eligibility conditions and clear the remaining selection stages for their chosen post.
 What should students and parents know about the October 30 school holiday? 
 The October 30 closure is an examination-related arrangement and not a general holiday across Uttar Pradesh.
 Parents should confirm the holiday through their school's official communication channels, especially if their institution is not being used as a PET examination centre. Students should also check whether online classes, internal assessments or other academic activities have been scheduled.
 Meanwhile, candidates appearing for UPSSSC PET 2026 should download their admit cards, check their examination centres and plan their travel in advance.
